goal: remove-redundant-checks S7 (Spec docs/specs/remove-redundant-checks.spec.md, Technical Design S7; U2, U3). The unattended batch layer drops positiveLimit, whose input every production entry already validates with parseMaxParallel, and merges the two topological traversals of batch_preflight.ts and batch_schedule.ts into one shared helper; each caller keeps its current error text, and batch_authority.ts keeps its own DFS. Lane instruction and session close parsing stay as they are. Execution posture: characterization-first. Delegated choices: the shared helper lives in batch_schedule.ts.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/unattended-batch-schedule.test.ts and tests/unattended-batch-lanes.test.ts, a two-Task cycle and a blocker naming an unknown Task are rejected by the preflight path with Initiative dependencies contain a cycle or unknown Task and by projectParallelGroups with Initiative Task dependencies must form an acyclic graph; parallel groups for a diamond and a chain are unchanged.

In tests/unattended-batch-schedule.test.ts and tests/unattended-batch-lanes.test.ts, startableChildren returns the same children for limits 1, 2, Infinity and above the child count, and parseMaxParallel still throws for 0, -1, 1.5 and a string.
bun run typecheck passes over the whole repository after the change, so no remaining import, re-export or call names a deleted or changed symbol.
